title: ranunculus flammula var. strigulosus
intro: Ranunculus flammula var. strigulosus, commonly known as lesser spearwort, is a plant species in the buttercup family, characterized by its distinctive, strigose leaves and stems. The lesser spearwort has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which can aid in the treatment of wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus flammula var. strigulosus include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
